messages:
gabriela-finance: Flagging an unexpected line on AWS invoice INV-AWS-2024-11-14. There's a positive charge of $7,200 labeled 'Distributor Settlement Recovery'—we never submitted a dispute/credit request for this. Anyone seen this before?
omar-partner-ops: Hmm that's odd. Distributor settlements usually show as separate payout adjustments, not charges. Do you have the marketplace order id or settlement ref?
gabriela-finance: Invoice PDF link: https://redwood.example.com/billing/INV-AWS-2024-11-14.pdf — line shows reference "dist-sett-4412" and marketplace order aws-ord-4412. No partner name on the line.
aws-marketplace-bot: Automated notice: Settlement dist-sett-4412 created 2024-11-13T22:04Z for aws-ord-4412. Amount due: 7200.00 USD. Documentation: https://console.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/settlements/dist-sett-4412 (login required).
kelly-ap: If it's an unexpected payable, we should treat as vendor charge until proven otherwise. Can AP hold payment pending partner confirmation? We need vendor remittance details.
omar-partner-ops: I'm pulling the settlement CSV now. Our internal routing shows aws-ord-4412 was proxied via Distributor D-12 (AtlasChannel). I'll ping the AtlasChannel rep to ask why there's a recovery charge.
ryan-revops: From a revenue recognition perspective: if this is a recovery (i.e., AWS charging us back a previous overpayment to distributor), it reduces our gross profit for the period. Need to classify GL: contra-revenue or an operating expense? Likely contra-revenue.
nora-cust-success: Also check whether any customer was affected. We had a promo for a few accounts routed through AtlasChannel in Sep. If Atlas reversed something, customers might have been credited upstream.
gabriela-finance: AP: please don't pay until we validate. I'll open a ticket with AWS marketplace support referencing dist-sett-4412.
aws-marketplace-bot: Case created: #MW-91234 regarding settlement dist-sett-4412. Expected support SLA: 3 business days.
omar-partner-ops: AtlasChannel rep replied: "we requested a recovery for reseller rebate previously over-applied due to misreported usage. Atlas confirmed with AWS and AWS issued recovery settlement." They attached an email but not a formal invoice to us.
kelly-ap: If it's a recovery from a prior rebate, do we owe anything to Atlas? Or is this AWS netting the rebate against our payable? We need the flow.
omar-partner-ops: Per Atlas: they consolidated rebate reconciliation and AWS netted against our invoice. So it's an AWS charge, not a direct payable to Atlas. We need the supporting reconciliation docs from Atlas to substantiate the amount.
ryan-revops: For the close: propose provisional treatment as contra-revenue for Nov (DR Revenue Reversal 4001 $7,200, CR AWS Payable 2105 $7,200) with memo "aws dist-sett-4412 recovery - pending partner docs". Tag as 'pending substantiation'.
gabriela-finance: Agree but need partner confirmation artifacts before finalizing. I'll draft JE as provisional. AP hold noted.
nora-cust-success: Atlas asked if we wanted to notify customers impacted by the original rebate reversal. Do we? 
gabriela-finance: Not yet—let's wait for Atlas docs. If the reversal affects customer billing lines we will coordinate.
omar-partner-ops: Atlas just uploaded a reconciliation spreadsheet (link in DM). It shows the recovery amount and affected orders. I'll add to the ticket and request a signed statement.
aws-marketplace-bot: Update: Ticket #MW-91234 updated by AWS support: "Settlement was issued per partner request. For documentation, contact distributor (AtlasChannel)."
kelly-ap: I'll keep payment blocked and mark vendor ledger entry with note "awaiting partner docs - dist-sett-4412".
ryan-revops: I'll include the provisional adjustment in November revenue waterfall and mark it as non-recurring adjustment.
gabriela-finance: Action items: (1) Omar to secure signed reconciliation from Atlas; (2) Kelly to hold payment and flag ledger; (3) Ryan to include provisional JE in Nov close; (4) Gabriela to escalate if Atlas docs not received in 5 business days. Update here when you have the document. :thumbsup:
omar-partner-ops: On it, pinged Atlas PM for signed reconciliation. Will paste when received.
